script.title: Word of the day: procrastinate

lines.text: My teacher says I procrastinate. Is that bad?
Ah, procrastinate means to keep putting things off.
If I procrastinate, I end up studying all night.
Kit's tip: it comes from Latin. Cras means tomorrow, so don't push it to tomorrow!
Look up any word on lexkite.com

script.caption: Word of the day: "procrastinate" = to keep putting things off
